name: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect

fee.note: USD list price plus tax where applicable. Every attempt is paid.

exam.format: 50–60 multiple choice and multiple select questions in 2 hours, including questions on 2 case studies (20–30% of the exam), online-proctored or at a test center (Pearson VUE since March 2026). English and Japanese. No prerequisites; Google recommends 3+ years of industry experience including 1+ year designing and managing solutions on Google Cloud.

scope: Designing, provisioning, securing, optimizing and operating Google Cloud solutions, guided by the Google Cloud Well-Architected Framework.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.
caveats: Google reports pass/fail only and does not publish a passing score.
Each exam uses 2 of the 4 case studies listed in the exam guide (Altostrat Media, Cymbal Retail, EHR Healthcare, KnightMotives Automotive), shown on a split screen during the exam.

Certified holders can renew with a shorter renewal exam (1 hour, 25 questions, $100) built almost entirely on one generative AI case study, or through designated courses and skill badges in Google Skills, which add one year.

access.retake: Up to four attempts in two years: wait 14 days after the first failure, 60 after the second and 365 after the third.

domains.name: Designing and planning a cloud solution architecture
Managing and provisioning a cloud solution infrastructure
Analyzing and optimizing technical and business processes
